sessionHeader: SYNTHETIC SESSION. Fictional client c03 (Farah S.), session 2026-10-14. Not a real person.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Hi Farah. How's the week been?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Busy. This exam schedule is killing me, honestly.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Tell me about the schedule.

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Four papers in six days. I'll die of embarrassment if I fail the stats one in front of my batch.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Stats is the worry?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Stats and the viva. But I've been following the 25-minute blocks more. Five days out of seven.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: That's a big improvement on last time. What helped?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: My friend Riya studies with me on video. We keep each other on track.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: So you've reconnected with friends a bit.

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: With Riya, yes. Not the whole group.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: How about the memory notebook?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: I wrote about Nani's biryani on Sunday. It made me smile, which surprised me.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: That sounds like a good moment. How's sleep?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Six hours. Better.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: What would help most this week?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: A plan for the viva. I freeze when they ask questions.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Let's practise two likely viva questions now, then you can do one mock with Riya.

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Okay, that sounds useful.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: And keep the study blocks as they are.

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Next session on the 21st?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Yes.
